rationale: Five distinct cycles kept finders read-only: soak-baseline patrol posture cites findings reported with evidence, fixes nothing, and closes with never repair never delete evidence; h0a logged unrelated incidents as recorded NOT resolved here; volt-comm routed drift findings to argus and operator; full-comm left uncommitted drift untouched per standing rule; THOTH-METAL W0 left pre-existing dirty state untouched. Adjacent but distinct from L009 (what automated remediation may touch once it acts) and rule 23 (bounded mechanical repair by tool): this assigns WHO repairs - detectors route, owners repair.

lesson.title: Finders report and route - detection lanes never repair inline
lesson.lesson: A lane whose job is detection (patrols, drift audits, reviews, health sweeps) records findings with cited command output and routes each to a named repair owner. It never repairs inline, never deletes evidence, and leaves pre-existing dirty state untouched. Repairs belong to designated owners: repair lanes or bounded mechanical tools. Mixing repair into detection destroys the independence that makes a finding trustworthy.
